{{Quote|I knew you Republic 'heroes' couldn't resist our little trap!|Kherr Dawar, to a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]|<ref name="TCWA">{{TCWA|Skirmish on Carlac: Captive Village}}</ref>}}
'''Kherr Dawar''' was a member of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] splinter group [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] who was assigned to await the arrival of a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] in a captive [[Ming Po/Legends|Ming Po]] [[City/Legends|village]] on [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]] during the [[Skirmish on Carlac|skirmish]] there. She combated the Knight with her wrist-mounted knives, but was eventually [[Death/Legends|killed]].
